Generated Narrative: ValueSet horizontal-deviation-direction-vs

  • Include these codes as defined in https://YasniiSS.github.io/fhir4eyes/CodeSystem/fhir4eyes-cs version 📦0.4.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    esodeviationEsodeviationInward (nasal) horizontal deviation of the eye; covers esotropia and esophoria.
    exodeviationExodeviationOutward (temporal) horizontal deviation of the eye; covers exotropia and exophoria.
    orthophoriaOrthophoriaAbsence of any manifest or latent ocular deviation; the visual axes remain aligned under cover testing.

name: HorizontalDeviationDirectionVS
title: Horizontal Deviation Direction Value Set
description:
Direction of a horizontal ocular deviation at a gaze position: esodeviation,
exodeviation, or orthophoria when no horizontal deviation is present. Covers both tropias
and phorias; the magnitude is recorded separately as a positive value.
